'''Chiiv''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] working with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Serving as an informant to [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], he revealed the existence of traitors among the guards in the [[Shadow Town]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] district. Chiiv, working alongside [[Imperial Agent|Agent]] [[Jalis]], identified the traitors and found that they had been taking bribes from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. However, the traitors found Jalis and killed him, prompting Chiiv to ask Imperial-aligned spacers to eliminate the traitors in order to save the guards that were still loyal.
